subtitleNew: A slide starts as a draft and is placed at the end of its placement. Its rank is then set from the list.
subtitleEdit: The preview shows what the public will see. The rank is set from the list.

nature.label: Kind of content
nature.hint: It gives the slide its label and colour. Kinds are managed in the reference data.

themes.label: Themes
themes.hint: At most three appear on a card; the rest fold into “+N”.

text.title: Title
text.titleHint: Your landmark in the list as much as the slide's title. French is required.
text.quoteHint: The text set large over the background. Choose the excerpt: trimming belongs to editing, not to layout.
text.bodyHint: Long text, for the detail page. It does not appear in the banner.

attribution.personHint: Chosen here, their name corrects itself if their profile changes.
attribution.authorNameOverridden: A person from the directory is selected: their name is the one that will show.
attribution.organizationHint: One record per organisation, whatever name it goes by.
attribution.organizationLabelHint: Only for an organisation missing from the directory.
attribution.organizationLabelBlocked: An organisation from the directory is selected: leave this field empty.
attribution.countryHint: Left empty, the organisation's country is used.

media.intro: Three slots: a photographic background, a video background, a thumbnail for the rail. Video wins over image, image over colour.
media.pending: A file is attached but is not yet ready to be served.
media.soon: Uploading arrives in the next phase.
media.colorHint: The banner background when no media is ready. Format #RRGGBB.

link.eventHint: It situates the slide and decides who may edit it.
link.platformHint: No edition: shown whichever COP is under way.
link.sessionHint: Optional. The chosen activity imposes its edition.
link.label: Link label
link.labelHint: “Read the full testimonial”. Without a link it has nowhere to lead.

broadcast.orderHint: Usually set from the list, with the move up and move down buttons.
broadcast.windowHint: UTC time: a slide shows across the whole platform and belongs to no local time zone.

stateHint.live: It is being shown to the public right now.
stateHint.scheduled: It will switch on by itself at the start date.
stateHint.expired: Its window has passed: it is published, yet nobody sees it.
stateHint.draft: A draft never goes out, whatever its window.
stateHint.archived: Withdrawn from the showcase. It stays here, and can be duplicated for the next edition.

errorSummary.title: Nothing was saved
errorSummary.description: {count} field needs correcting. | {count} field needs correcting. | {count} fields need correcting.

error.window_inverted: The broadcast end must come after its start.
error.organization_both: An organisation is either picked from the directory OR named freely, never both.
error.link_label_without_url: This label has nowhere to lead: fill in the link, or clear the label.
error.session_event_mismatch: This activity belongs to a different edition from the one selected.
error.color_format: The colour is written as #RRGGBB, six hexadecimal digits.
error.french_required: French is required: it is the fallback language of the whole platform.
error.url_format: A full address is expected, starting with http:// or https://.
error.global_scope_required: Content without an edition shows across the whole platform: it requires global scope.
error.forbidden: This slide is outside your administration scope.
error.network: The save did not go through. Try again in a moment.

background.label: Background used
background.none: No media: the institutional background will show

notFound.title: Slide not found
notFound.description: This slide does not exist, or has been removed from the model.
